dedupe_keys.name: ligne des reseaux de transport en commun de l isere

description: Ligne des réseaux de transport en commun de l'Isère is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.e2.rie.gouv.fr. This dataset lists the lines in circulation for each public transit system. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Isère Public Transit Network Line" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2018-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
